resources.name: Bonded Object Spell
resources.description: Once per day, a Wizard with a bonded object may cast one Wizard spell from the spellbook even if it was not prepared. The spell must be of a level the Wizard can cast and is cast normally through the bonded object.

notes: School powers and their exact rules are projected from the selected Arcane School. A familiar is handled by the shared bonded-companion page; a bonded object exposes its daily spell use through the shared class-resource controls.
